title: Bond Bridge
passages: Bond Bridge is a Wi-Fi device that communicates with infra-red or RF controlled devices, such as ceiling fans, shades, and fireplaces.  These devices often come with a battery powered remote control.  The bond bridge receives commands form a network port, and it forwards the commands to the remote controlled device by simulating the signals the remote control would produce.
The photo shows a bond bridge in the dining room of Baywood Court, a senior community.  The bond bridge controls ceiling fans in the dining room.
Broadlink RM4 is a competing product.
